about: S3.1 drafting — the TUNING set. Fictional documents only. demand-northwind, review-warehouse-lease and nda-missing-period were the first held-out set; they informed code fixes (D-045, four reported runs), so they became tuning data at the Phase 3 gate (S3.9). engagement-corran, demand-brightwater and nda-no-law were the second held-out set (run on s3.1, then on s3.1b where the agreement field took a party's name); that informed s3.1c, so they became tuning data. review-kestrel-distribution, demand-pinewood-rent and engagement-ashcombe-no-fee were the third held-out set (run once on s3.1c: 5/9, wrong 0); it showed the research abstention floor emptying drafting's search on a short email, fixed in s3.1d, so they became tuning data.
